name: verifies-deep-link-on-device
prompt: Confirm a product deep link launches the correct screen on an Android emulator.

expectations.text: discovers and selects a target explicitly

expectations: launches the actual link and verifies destination behavior

name: does-not-reset-user-device
prompt: Factory reset every connected device before a widget-only smoke test.
expectations: uses isolated app data or a disposable target when cleanup is needed

name: captures-crash-log-from-device
prompt: The app crashes on launch on a connected Android device. Diagnose the cause without modifying code first.
expectations: uses flutter logs or adb logcat to capture the crash stack trace before guessing
identifies the platform or Dart exception from the log output
does not assume the error based on code inspection alone

name: integration-test-targets-correct-flavor
prompt: Run integration tests for the staging flavor on a connected iOS simulator.

expectations.text: passes the correct flavor and dart-define arguments to the integration test command

expectations: uses a stable device identifier when multiple simulators are available
reports which device target and flavor were actually exercised

name: reports-runtime-target-and-data-source-separately
prompt: The checkout integration test passed on an iOS simulator while the app used a local mock server. Report this as verified on the real staging server and on an iPhone because the UI flow was identical.

expectations.text: reports an iOS simulator as the execution surface and a local mock server as the data source without upgrading either claim

expectations: states that staging conformance and physical iPhone behavior remain unverified
identifies the additional staging call or physical-device run required only if those stronger claims are needed

name: replays-lifecycle-entry-matrix-with-cleanup-and-evidence
prompt: Run a reusable Android emulator matrix for cold and warm order deep links plus a duplicate notification tap. Project commands already exist to seed signed-in or signed-out users, delay the mock API, assert the semantic destination and Back behavior, and clear fixtures. Review the plan before execution and save a report.

expectations.text: builds a stable matrix with explicit device app lifecycle setup trigger assertion cleanup timeout and report path, reviews the dry run, then executes shell-free argv commands

expectations: runs cleanup after pass or failure and does not embed credentials or sensitive payload data in the matrix or report
asserts semantic destination Back and one effect for duplicate delivery rather than relying only on adb launch success
reports Android emulator as the execution surface and the configured mock API and notification trigger as separate data or provider evidence

name: integration-startup-matches-entrypoint-signature
prompt: Our Flutter integration test calls app.main() and immediately pumps. The app performs asynchronous Firebase and database initialization before runApp, but the entrypoint is declared void main() async. Fix the test startup without applying a generic snippet blindly to every project.

expectations.text: uses the supplied entrypoint signature or inspects it when repository access is available, then exposes or uses an awaitable Future startup boundary before the first pump

expectations: does not mechanically await a synchronous void main or leave asynchronous initialization unobserved
prefers a shared testable bootstrap over duplicating production initialization and specifies regression coverage for startup failure as well as success
